lost.finding: Witness CAS advanced to the actual receipt-z journal before suppressing its reply; sink returned 503 with local commit recorded, then a fresh check admitted the next operation and two same-file cold recoveries retained prior ACK, z, and later effect.

positive.finding: Delivered publication receipt produced the positive ACK; later operation and current-file recovery retained journal effects.

rejected.finding: Delivered 503 rejection left witness at the old cut; z remained locally committed, later append was blocked, and startup refused without changing the journal.

qualification: One selected live witness/current-root receipt-loss experiment. Does not establish witness power-loss durability, nonrollback against hostile storage, reconciliation of genuine divergence, or generic C7/F4 proof.
